description: Lara pursues the peril stones across several countries, uncovering the history behind them while Devereaux’s obsession turns an archaeological chase into a supernatural threat.

s01e01.description: A theft at Croft Manor sends Lara after a mysterious jade artifact and the mercenary who took it.

s01e02.description: Lara and Jonah follow the thief into China, where missing children and an underground tomb point to a larger mystery.

s01e03.description: Devereaux reveals why he wants the peril stones while Lara infiltrates a heavily guarded compound in Istanbul.

s01e04.description: Lara and Camilla descend into the Paris catacombs and uncover a link between the peril stones and the Knights Templar.

s01e05.description: A chase through Iran puts Lara on a speeding train as she tries to free an old friend from supernatural control.

s01e06.description: An astronomical clue leads Lara toward an ancient battlefield and the last peril stone hidden beneath a legendary golden tree.

s01e07.description: Lara and Camilla race to separate the peril stones from Devereaux as their power begins changing him into something monstrous.

s01e08.description: On Kunlun Mountain, Lara faces supernatural trials and a colossal threat while trying to restore balance to the world.
